description: This file defines the ServerCommand class for Drupal, which manages starting a local PHP webserver for development and testing, including port management, browser launching, and Drupal environment bootstrapping.

classes.name: ServerCommand
classes.description: A command class for managing a local PHP webserver for a Drupal site, including environment setup, port selection, and browser automation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ServerCommand with a class loader.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures command options and usage instructions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to start the server, handling port selection and environment bootstrapping.

methods.name: boot
methods.description: Boots the Drupal environment and initializes necessary services.

methods.name: findAvailablePort
methods.description: Finds an available network port between 8888 and 9999.

methods.name: openBrowser
methods.description: Opens a URL in the system's default browser, handling different OS commands.

methods.name: getOneTimeLoginUrl
methods.description: Generates a one-time login URL for user ID 1.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the PHP built-in webserver with Drupal, manages process output, and displays server info.

methods.name: getSitePath
methods.description: Returns the Drupal site path, defaulting to 'sites/default' or overridden by environment variable.
